cases.note: a pie in ec3 spelling: itemStyle, label (its textStyle inside normal) and labelLine with normal and emphasis; a data item's own
clockWise, hoverOffset (written null: no growth on hover) and a label margin with alignTo edge
a bar in ec2 spelling: the label inside itemStyle.normal / .emphasis, barBorderRadius / Color / Width, a data item's own
the ec3 mix: focus and blurScope inside itemStyle.emphasis lift into emphasis
a line: lineStyle, areaStyle, itemStyle, label in ec3 spelling; clipOverflow, hoverAnimation
a label written with only an emphasis (and a textStyle in it): the emphasis object stands in two places, both take the text style
a graph: categories, nodes and links in ec3 spelling, an edge label's textStyle, focusNodeAdjacency
focusNodeAdjacency is rewritten in the option that has it: a later merge's emphasis.focus null turns the focus off
a sankey: focusNodeAdjacency ('allEdges' is adjacency), lineStyle and itemStyle in ec3 spelling
a map: mapType, mapLocation (x / y into left / top), ec3 itemStyle and label, a region's own
a geo: x / y, ec3 itemStyle, a label with only an emphasis (two places, the text style in both), a region's own
a gauge: clockWise, the textStyle of its axisLabel, title and detail; pointer.color is never read
a funnel: x / y / x2 / y2 as its box, ec3 itemStyle, label and labelLine
ec2: polars with an indicator are radars (type as shape), a radar series' polarIndex its radarIndex
a radar's name (its textStyle copied up) is its axisName, nameGap its axisNameGap
type 'k' is the candlestick; its itemStyle in ec3 spelling
a treemap: levels, upperLabel, breadcrumb.itemStyle in ec3 spelling; a child's own itemStyle.normal is NOT rewritten (only the top data items are)
a sunburst: highlightPolicy as emphasis.focus, downplay as blur (the series' and every node's), ec3 itemStyle and label
a tree: itemStyle, lineStyle, label and its leaves' in ec3 spelling
markPoint / markLine / markArea: ec2 itemStyle.normal.label, ec3 lineStyle and label, a marker datum's own, a pair's end
a calendar: its itemStyle in ec3 spelling, the textStyle of its day, month and year labels; a heatmap on it
an axis label's and an axis pointer label's textStyle
x / y / x2 / y2 on a title, a legend, a grid, a toolbox and a slider dataZoom; the toolbox's iconStyle in ec3 spelling
dataRange is the visualMap: its splitList (start / end) its pieces, x / y its left / top; the root dataRange stays the same object
a timeline in ec3 spelling (label, itemStyle, controlStyle with its own keys, a data item's label, x / x2 / y2); frames in ec3 spelling, the second with only an emphasis
a timeline itemStyle with only an emphasis, a label in it: the timeline preprocessor moves the label out of both places
a media unit with a query is preprocessed: its ec3 itemStyle and label apply
the media default is never preprocessed: its ec3 itemStyle and label stay as written and draw nothing
a merge in ec3 spelling is rewritten; with no type in it, its barBorderRadius is not
